3.Then, categorised accordingly, enter the information in the “incident log” to see if there is a 到的incident record.
4. Then, according to the incident records, find the accident of the same type of occurrence, and then enter the accident information in the “incident log” under the same type.
# Instructions for identifying the reportable accident

1. If the injuries involved in the incident logs contain missing injury, then the accident is considered a missing injury so that the incident is deemed as a lost time incident.
2. If the injuries related to the incident logs included two or more reportable injuries, then the incident was a Lost Time Incident and it was considered as a permanent partial disability.
3. If there are no other recordable injuries, the incident record is considered as a minor injury.
4. When it comes to permanent disability to an employee at the company, the employee is considered as a person
